title: FANTASTIC EXPERIENCE WITH COME2INDONESIA
text:
Our experience with Come2Indonesia has been fantastic from beginning to end.

Jacob took care of organizing our entire trip before arriving in Indonesia and from the first moment he understood perfectly what we were looking for. He adapted the circuit to our instructions and our budget, taking into account the type of islands we wanted to visit and the style of hotels we like. Everything was perfectly coordinated: he sent us all the vouchers and necessary information in advance, organized the internal flights and all the transfers, and was always attentive to ensure everything worked correctly
author: I7159IBmelaniem

title: Wine Tour & tasting Penedes region
text:
Absolutely superb trip to two vineyards with exceptional tour guides; one being the owner of a vineyard dating back hundreds of years and the other a highly experienced sommelier working in the wine industry. Both vineyards were really different but both beautiful. We had lots of delicious samples to try! We liked them all. 
We also had a great organiser from Sitges Cycle Tours in Lorec who drove us from Sitges to the vineyards.
And fabulous  people on our tour which made it such fun. 
I highly recommend this tour.

title: Pleasurable winery tour!
text:
Thank you for an awesome afternoon exploring the two local wineries.  
Despite it being just the two of us, we had a great time ably supported by Alex.  
The two wineries were completely different in their approach to manufacture but equally fascinating.  
The food and drink samples were amazing at showcasing their available stock which was also for sale.  
Would thoroughly recommend this trip to anyone!
author: Evelina S

title: Great Trip
text: Loved it. Pick up from the hotel. Amazing guide and the wine was utterly exceptional. Fascinating history of both wineries. Very relaxed half day tour. Never normally buy stuff on trips like these but walked away with 4 bottles between us and there was never any pressure to buy anything. Would highly recommend this trip
author: 64JimmyJazz

title: A Perfect Bike Ride and Cava Experience
text:
A fantastic and unique experience combining nature, activity, and great wine. The bike ride was the perfect way to explore the beautiful surroundings—peaceful, scenic, and suitable for all levels, making it both enjoyable and relaxing.

The visit to Rovellats winery was equally impressive. The guided tour was engaging and informative, giving great insight into the history and craftsmanship behind their cavas. The highlight, of course, was the tasting: a wonderful selection of cavas, each with its own character, explained with passion and expertise.

The whole experience was very well organized

title: Fun half day winery tour
text: Great tour hosted by our driver and tour guide, Alex. We visited an older and a newly reopened winery. Very informative and friendly hosts at both locations. Would recommend to others who are looking for a fun and informative half day tour!
